mapper.sql: p.id, p.ec_name AS ecName, p.ec_title AS ecTitle, p.selling_points AS sellingPoints, p.attrs AS attrs, p.status AS status, p.remark AS remark, p.ec_category_id AS ecCategoryId, p.create_by AS createBy, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_by AS updateBy, p.update_time AS updateTime, CONCAT(e.ec_l1, ' › ', e.ec_l2) AS ecCategoryPath, e.pdd_cat_id AS pddCatId, e.tb_cat_id AS tbCatId, e.dy_cat_id AS dyCatId, (SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT b.brand_name ORDER BY b.brand_name SEPARATOR ' / '), '') FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id LEFT JOIN wms_item_brand b ON b.id = i.item_brand WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id) AS brands, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ec_product_item pi WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id) AS itemCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id JOIN wms_item_sku s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id) AS skuCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id JOIN wms_item_sku s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id AND (s.selling_price IS NULL OR s.selling_price = 0)) AS noPriceCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id JOIN wms_item_sku s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id AND s.cost_price IS NULL) AS noCostCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id JOIN wms_item_sku s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id AND s.gross_weight IS NOT NULL) AS weighedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id JOIN wms_item_sku s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id AND s.pack_length IS NOT NULL) AS packedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item_media m ON m.item_id = pi.item_id WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id) AS mediaCount

where.if: AND ( p.ec_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.keyword}, '%') OR p.ec_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.keyword}, '%') OR CONCAT(e.ec_l1, e.ec_l2) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id JOIN wms_item_brand b ON b.id = i.item_brand WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id AND b.brand_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.keyword}, '%')) )

AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id JOIN wms_item_sku s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id AND (s.selling_price IS NULL OR s.selling_price = 0)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id AND i.item_brand IS NULL) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id JOIN wms_item_sku s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE pi.ec_product_id = p.id) BETWEEN 1 AND 10

ORDER BY e.order_num, p.ec_name
SELECT FROM ec_product p JOIN ec_category e ON e.id = p.ec_category_id WHERE p.id IN #{id} ORDER BY e.order_num, p.ec_name

SELECT s.id AS skuId, s.sku_name AS skuName, b.brand_name AS brandName, i.unit AS unit, s.cost_price AS costPrice, s.selling_price AS sellingPrice, s.net_weight AS netWeight, s.gross_weight AS grossWeight, s.pack_length AS packLength, s.pack_width AS packWidth, s.pack_height AS packHeight, sp.spec AS spec, sp.confidence AS confidence FROM ec_product_item pi JOIN wms_item i ON i.id = pi.item_id JOIN wms_item_sku s ON s.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN wms_item_brand b ON b.id = i.item_brand LEFT JOIN ec_sku_spec sp ON sp.sku_id = s.id WHERE pi.ec_product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY b.brand_name, s.sku_name
